authoredConstructionReuse.scope: Only original-authored structure; no source pixels or source palette copied into output.

A.description: 霧紫陶面、單枚淡金菱形印與兩個深紫小定位印，無環狀橫條。
A.risk: 菱形需在受壓時縮短並在裂口處遮擋。
A.title: 月印紫陶蛋

B.description: 高對比紫晶切面與多條放射裂光。
B.risk: 固定裝飾裂光會混淆原本漸進裂殼狀態。
B.title: 紫晶碎面蛋

designAlternatives.rationale: 以單一大菱印建立身份，不延續來源橫條，也不提前暗示破裂。

faceRules: Egg surface contains no eyes, face or emerging character.
The original interior remains abstract dark/red structure; light appears only in its source states.
features: 霧紫陶面、單枚淡金菱形印與兩個深紫小定位印，無環狀橫條。
ornamentRules: All marks lie flush on shell surfaces.
Crack lines, split-shell fragments, voids and source light occlude surface decoration.
No separate vines, crystal spikes or orbiting ornaments.
